Controller edits / agent access
|-- MappingDocumentController coordinates edits
|   |-- ~ private snapshot: ControllerSnapshot; private context: CanvasEditingContext
|   |-- It retains document/canvas state, listeners, node cache and node correspondence.
|   |-- ~ nodes() -> canvasDisplayNodes(snapshot...) -> structuredClone(nodes)
|   `-- Cached display nodes are read projections, not another writable store.
|-- Shared command boundary
|   |-- ~ transact(expectedVersion, operations) -> applyUpdate(...) -> applyOperations(...)
|   |   `-- The batch checks the expected version and stages one to 100 operations on a clone.
|   |-- ~ prepareDiagramEdit(document, id, edit) -> diagrams.revise(current.revisionId, edit)
|   |   `-- Later operations see preceding staged edits without advancing the live head.
|   |-- ~ patchDiagram -> nodeIds + lineAfter -> edges / jumps / views / sections
|   |   `-- Patch correspondence updates supported anchors and ranges before layout.
|   |-- ~ diagram-create -> diagrams.create(...); diagram-insert -> diagrams.getRevision(...)
|   |-- Revision application checks the expected diagram revision before receiving it.
|   |-- ~ move/group/collapse/remove -> updateGridBox / layoutScene / display reducers
|   |   `-- Grid moves require cells; floating moves require finite pixels and become manual.
|   `-- Edge creation/update validates anchors; arrows cannot be moved independently.
|-- Publication and history
|   |-- ~ updateSnapshot(next, record) -> reconcileConnections + normalizeDiagramViews
|   |   `-- Recorded document changes validate edges and rebase supported jumps.
|   |-- ~ record => historyService.append(context, document, canvas, pendingNodeIds)
|   |   `-- Unrecorded selection/layout updates do not advance history.
|   |-- ~ select(command) -> updateCanvas(updateSelection(...), true)
|   |   `-- Explicit selection commands are recorded; snapshot listeners receive final state.
|   `-- ~ undo(redo) -> historyService.navigate(context, redo)
`-- Agent transport and page dispatch
    |-- ~ useAgentCanvasBridge(descriptor, handle, workspace?)
    |   `-- The hook manages its ephemeral canvas ID, abort controller, timer and receipt cache.
    |-- ~ register -> GET commands -> latest.handle(command) -> POST reply
    |   `-- Mutations cache at most 200 receipts; context reads are fresh.
    |-- ~ cleanup -> abort(); clearTimeout(timer); unregister()
    |-- A separate effect publishes live workspace selections and connection status.
    |-- ~ handleAgentCommand('context') -> getSnapshot() + nodes() + cloned edges
    |-- The page routes commands to available, visible draft controllers.
    |-- ~ handleAgentCommand('apply') -> controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
    |   `-- Page request receipts prevent duplicate application; busy drafts reject edits.
    `-- ~ apply-diagram-revision -> revisionReceiver.apply(..., sync-and-flush callback)
